Title: Product Catalog: already-imported products can be re-selected and 're-imported' via the bulk path; the success toast over-counts
Feature: Product Catalog - checkbox selection / bulk 'Import selected'
Description: The per-row 'Import' button correctly turns into a disabled 'Imported' badge once a product is in My Products. The row CHECKBOX, however, stays enabled for those same products, 'Select All' includes them, and 'Import selected' happily re-submits them. Bulk-importing a set that contains an already-imported product returns requestedProducts:N / excludedProducts:0 / importedProducts:N and a toast 'N imported' - so it claims to have imported items that were already present. No duplicate row is created in My Products (net data is correct), but the count and message are wrong and the checkbox/button behaviour is inconsistent.
Preconditions: Manik Pharma; at least one Product Catalog product already imported (Status = 'Imported').
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Product Catalog. 2. Tick the checkbox of a row whose Status is 'Imported', plus two fresh rows. 3. Click 'Import selected (3)'. 4. Observe toast 'Imported - Selected products have been imported successfully' and the API response importedProducts:3, excludedProducts:0.
Test Data: productIds included id 10 (already-imported '100%') -> response {requestedProducts:7, excludedProducts:0, importedProducts:7}
Expected Result: Already-imported products are either not selectable (checkbox disabled, excluded from Select All) or are reported as excluded (excludedProducts > 0) and the toast reflects only the products actually added.
Actual Result: Already-imported products are selectable and counted as newly imported; excludedProducts is always 0; toast over-states the result.
Evidence: network: POST /api/1.0.0/secured/pharmacy-products/import/606 {mode:'SELECTED',productIds:[2,4,5,7,6,27431,10]} -> {importedProducts:7,excludedProducts:0}
Remarks: Re-tested 2026-09-09: the importedProducts OVER-COUNT is fixed - bulk-importing [fresh id 32742 + already-imported id 3] now returns importedProducts:1 (was N). Still open: the already-imported row's checkbox is NOT disabled and IS sent in the payload, and excludedProducts is still reported as 0 (should be 1). Net data stays correct (KPI +1, no duplicate row). Severity accordingly lowered to Low. Also a UX inconsistency: per-row button is disabled after import, the checkbox is not.

Title: Add New Product cannot create a product - backend requires Cost per box but the field is disabled and unpopulated
Description: The 'Add New Product' form cannot create a product. On submit the backend returns 'Cost per box must not be null', but the Cost/Box field (lastPurchasePricePerBox) is rendered DISABLED, is not marked required, has no inline validation, and there is no other UI path to populate it. A product could only be created by injecting costPerBox through the framework (POST .../pharmacy-products/create/606 with costPerBox succeeds -> 201). Regular users are fully blocked from creating products via this form.
Preconditions: Manik Pharma; My Products > Add New Product open; all visible required fields filled with valid data.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open My Products > Add New Product. 2. Fill Product Name, Product Type, Company, Qty/Box, Retail Price/Box, Wholesale Price/Box with valid values. 3. Click 'Confirm New Product'. 4. Observe the error toast 'Error - Cost per box must not be null'; drawer stays open; no product created (Total Products unchanged).
Test Data: QA SEED PRODUCT 260908 FULL / IM INJECTION / ABBOTT LABORATORIES / 10 / 120 / 100
Expected Result: Either Cost/Box is enabled and (if mandatory) validated client-side with a friendly message, or the backend does not require it, or it is derived server-side. A user can create a product end to end.
Actual Result: Submit fails with 'Cost per box must not be null'; the required field is disabled with no way to fill it; product is not created.
Evidence: network: POST /api/1.0.0/secured/pharmacy-products/create/606 -> {"errors":["Cost per box must not be null"]}; screenshots/add-product-drawer.png
Status: Fixed (core blocker) - follow-ups open as BUG-PROD-006
Remarks: Matches the example defect named in the task brief. 04:49 UTC 2026-09-09: still fully broken (Cost/Box DISABLED, body has no costPerBox, 400). RE-TESTED 07:28 UTC 2026-09-09: the app was updated - Cost/Box is now ENABLED and editable, accepts 0, and a full form submit with costPerBox:0 CREATES the product (POST .../pharmacy-products/create/598 -> 201, product id 41006, costPerBox:0). The disabled-field blocker is resolved. Two follow-ups remain (see BUG-PROD-006): the field is required by the backend but shows NO asterisk and has NO client-side required rule, so an empty Cost/Box still yields a silent 400 with no UI feedback.

Title: Add New Product Type cannot create a type - raw backend errors ('expected a value of type int', missing slug) shown to the user
Feature: Product Type List > Add New Product Type
Description: The Add Product Type form has ONLY a 'Product Type Name' field, but the backend create endpoint requires 'sortOrder' (int) and 'slug'. Submitting the form fails, and the raw backend error is surfaced directly in a toast: first 'Invalid value for field 'sortOrder': expected a value of type int.', then after injecting sortOrder, 'Product type slug must not be blank'. A type could only be created by injecting slug + sortOrder into the POST body via the framework (-> 201). Regular users cannot create a product type at all.
Preconditions: Manik Pharma; Customizations > Product Type List > Add New Product Type.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Customizations > Product Type List. 2. Click 'Add New Product Type'. 3. Enter a name. 4. Click 'Confirm New Product Type'. 5. Observe the error toast: "Invalid value for field 'sortOrder': expected a value of type int."
Test Data: Name: QA SEED TYPE 260908 01
Expected Result: The form collects everything the backend needs (or the backend defaults slug/sortOrder). Any validation failure shows a user-friendly message, never a raw type/serialization error.
Actual Result: Creation fails; the toast shows the literal backend message including 'expected a value of type int'; then 'Product type slug must not be blank'. No type is created.
Evidence: network: POST /api/1.0.0/secured/product-types/for-pharmacy/create/606 -> 400 {"errors":["Product type slug must not be blank"]} REGRESSION-CONFIRMED 2026-09-16: identical POST .../product-types/for-pharmacy/create/598 -> 400 {"message":"Invalid value for field 'sortOrder': expected a value of type int."}.
Remarks: The task brief explicitly calls out that raw errors like 'expected a value of type int' must not be shown - reproduced verbatim. Two missing required fields: sortOrder and slug. Reconfirmed twice on 2026-09-09 (pharmacy 606 and 598), deterministic. See BUG-PTYPE-002 for the matching Edit failure. Regression-confirmed unchanged on 2026-09-16 (~1 week later, pharmacy 598). NEW OBSERVATION: this run showed NO toast/visible error to the user at all (silent failure) - previously the raw backend message was at least surfaced in a toast, so user-facing behavior may have quietly regressed further even though the root create-path defect is identical.

Title: Staging serves an unbuilt Vite development build to end users
Description: The staging deployment loads the raw Vite dev client instead of a production bundle. Console shows '@vite/client', repeated HMR websocket attempts to wss://localhost:5000, a 'Download the React DevTools' notice, dev-only class names (css-dev-only-do-not-override-*), and source paths like /src/features/pharmacy/PharmacyList.tsx are exposed. This leaks source structure, ships React dev warnings to users, and degrades performance.
Preconditions: Open https://pms-sql-portal.ems24.co/ in a browser with devtools open.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to https://pms-sql-portal.ems24.co/login. 2. Open browser DevTools > Console and Network. 3. Observe @vite/client, failing wss://localhost:5000 HMR socket, React DevTools message, and *.tsx paths in stack traces.
Test Data: n/a

Actual Result: Vite dev client is served; HMR socket to localhost:5000 fails on a loop; dev-only React warnings and TSX source paths are visible to any user.
Remarks: Also the root cause of the failing WebSocket handshake (wss returns HTTP 200). Fix by deploying `vite build` output behind the static host. Still present 2026-09-09 (@vite/client, HMR loop to wss://localhost:5000). Likely compounds BUG-API-001 (non-production infra config).

Title: Intermittent API failures (missing CORS header / 500 / 404) with no frontend error handling - every list silently shows 'no data'
Feature: All list screens (My Products, Product Catalog, Company/Generic/Product Type lists, pharmacy picker)
Description: During the 2026-09-09 session pms-sql-api.ems24.co began failing broadly (it was healthy 04:42-05:15 UTC). Symptoms seen inconsistently across endpoints: (a) CORS preflight with no 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header -> net::ERR_FAILED on GET .../product-types/for-pharmacy/606 and .../companies/for-pharmacy/606; (b) HTTP 500 on GET /users/profile (also drops the session -> redirect to /login); (c) HTTP 404 on GET .../pharmacy-products/606 and .../pharmacy-products/total-count/606; (d) the pharmacy picker returned a truncated list (4 of 12) and a duplicate-named 'Manik Pharma' (id 598, empty) instead of the real one (id 606). The React app has NO handling for any of this: the affected screen just renders 'Total X: 0 / Showing 0-0 of 0 / No data found' with no error banner, no retry, and no toast.

Title: Add New Product has no client-side guards on numeric fields - negative price and zero Qty/Box reach the backend
Feature: Add New Product drawer - numeric field validation
Description: quantityInBox, retailPricePerBox and wholesalePricePerBox are AntD InputNumber fields with no min / step-enforced lower bound and no inline validation. A Retail Price/Box of -5 passes client validation and is sent as retailPricePerBox:-5 (backend then rejects it: 'Retail price per box must be zero or greater'). A Qty/Box of 0 passes BOTH client and server validation (the create request with quantityInBox:0 is not flagged for quantity at all) - a product with 0 units per box is nonsensical and creates a divide-by-zero risk in the per-piece price the My Products list derives (retail/piece = perBox / qty).
Preconditions: Manik Pharma; My Products > Add New Product open, visible required fields otherwise valid.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Add New Product. 2. Set Qty/Box = 0, Retail Price/Box = -5, Wholesale = 0. 3. Click 'Confirm New Product'. 4. Observe no inline errors; request is sent with quantityInBox:0, retailPricePerBox:-5; server 400 mentions only cost + retail, never quantity 0.
Test Data: POST .../pharmacy-products/create/606 {quantityInBox:0, retailPricePerBox:-5, wholesalePricePerBox:0} -> 400 errors:['Cost per box must not be null','Retail price per box must be zero or greater']
Expected Result: Client-side: prices constrained to >= 0 with an inline message; Qty/Box constrained to >= 1. Server-side: quantityInBox:0 rejected with a clear message.
Actual Result: Negative price and zero quantity are accepted by the form; only the price is caught (server-side, as a toast); zero quantity is accepted end to end.
Evidence: network: create/606 request bodies with quantityInBox:0 and retailPricePerBox:-5; response errors array
Remarks: Discovered 2026-09-09. Multi-error responses also expose BUG-PROD-003: the toast shows only errors[0] ('Cost per box must not be null'), hiding 'Retail price per box must be zero or greater'.
